desktopOnly.title: Desktop required
desktopOnly.body: MeshCore Companion connects to your radio over USB Serial and Bluetooth — browser features that aren't available on phones or tablets. Please open this site on a desktop or laptop computer.

connect.title: Connect to MeshCore
connect.subtitle: Connect via USB, Bluetooth, or WiFi to your Companion Radio.

usb.info: Uses Web Serial API (Chrome / Edge). Connect your MeshCore Companion via USB cable.
usb.unsupported: USB is not supported in this browser. Use a supported browser like Chrome to connect over USB.

ble.info: Uses Web Bluetooth API (Chrome). Scans for devices advertising the Nordic UART service.
ble.infoExtra: Don't see your companion? It may already be connected to another device, like your phone's MeshCore app. Disconnect it there first.
ble.unsupported: Bluetooth is not supported in this browser. Use a supported browser like Chrome to connect over BLE.

wifi.info: Connects via WebSocket. Same frame protocol as USB serial.
wifi.infoExtra: Can't reach your companion? It may already be connected to another device, like your phone's MeshCore app. Disconnect it there first.

sync.title: Syncing with radio
sync.loadingGeneric: Loading stored data from your companion radio.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting…
reconnecting.bodyFrom: Lost the connection to {{device}}. Trying to restore it automatically — your chats will reappear as soon as it's back.
reconnecting.bodyGeneric: Lost the connection to your companion radio. Trying to restore it automatically — your chats will reappear as soon as it's back.
reconnecting.hint: A rebooting radio can take a moment to come back.
reconnecting.resyncFrom: Reconnected to {{device}} — restoring your contacts and messages.
reconnecting.resyncGeneric: Reconnected — restoring your contacts and messages.

autoAdd.title: ⚙ Auto-add settings

all.label: Auto Add All
all.hint: Save every node the radio hears

selected.label: Auto Add Selected
selected.hint: Only save the node types you choose

autoAdd.overwriteOldest: Overwrite oldest non-favorite when contacts are full
autoAdd.maxHopsHint: Only add nodes heard within this many hops (0 = direct only; far right = no limit).
autoAdd.showPublicKeys: Show public keys in contact details

chat.empty: Select a channel or contact to start chatting
chat.noAckTooltip: The message may still have arrived — the acknowledgment can be lost in route
chat.resetRouteRetryTooltip: Discard the saved route to this contact and resend via flood
chat.placeholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)

manage.removeChannelConfirm: Remove this channel from the radio?
manage.publicChannelCantRemove: The Public channel cannot be removed
manage.removeContactConfirm: Remove this contact from the radio?
manage.zeroHopAdvertHint: Re-broadcast this contact's advert to nearby nodes
manage.name: Name

routeChip.noRoute: No route known — messages flood the mesh until a reply establishes a path.
routeChip.directNeighbor: Direct neighbor — no repeaters in between.
routeChip.resetExplain: Discards this route. Messages will flood the mesh until a new route is found.

discover.title: 📡 Discovered nodes
discover.empty: No adverts heard yet. Discovered nodes appear here as their adverts arrive.

mode.createHint: Generates a random secret key. Share it so others can join.
mode.joinPrivateHint: Enter the channel name and its 16-byte secret key (hex).
mode.joinHashtagHint: Hashtag channels are public — anyone entering the same name joins. Use a–z, 0–9, and hyphens only.

error.invalidSecret: Secret key must be 32 hex characters (16 bytes).

message.broadcastSent: Broadcast sent — channels have no delivery receipts
message.sentFloodAwaiting: Sent via flood — awaiting delivery confirmation

toast.radioNoResponse: Radio did not respond — try reconnecting
toast.routeReset: Route reset — next message will flood
toast.advertNoRecent: Can't share: your radio hasn't heard a recent advert from this contact
